domains.name: The EDA Landscape
domains.description: What electronic design automation is, the RTL-to-GDSII flow stage by stage, the representations each stage consumes and produces, PPA, the industry and its history.

domains.name: Boolean Reasoning and Complexity
domains.description: Boolean functions, cofactors, Shannon expansion, covers and clauses, and the complexity theory that explains why every EDA problem needs heuristics.

domains.name: Graph Algorithms for EDA
domains.description: Netlists as hypergraphs, partitioning (KL, FM, multilevel, spectral), shortest paths and A*, flows, Steiner trees and the graph machinery under placement, routing and timing.

domains.name: Computational Geometry for Layout
domains.description: Rectilinear geometry, polygon Booleans, plane sweep and spatial indexes: the kernels under DRC, extraction, fill and routing.

domains.name: Optimization for EDA
domains.description: LP, ILP, convex and nonconvex optimization, Lagrangian relaxation, metaheuristics, dynamic programming and Bayesian optimization, each tied to the EDA problem it solves.

domains.name: Numerical Methods for EDA
domains.description: Sparse linear algebra, Newton's method, stiff ODE integration, Krylov solvers, PDE discretization and model order reduction for simulators and analyzers.

domains.name: Variability, Yield and Reliability Statistics
domains.description: Monte Carlo and rare-event estimation, process variation, statistical timing mathematics, yield models and lifetime statistics.

domains.name: Circuits and Electromagnetics
domains.description: Circuit laws, RC and RLC dynamics, transfer functions, transmission lines, S-parameters and the field physics behind parasitics and signal integrity.

domains.name: Semiconductor Devices and Compact Models
domains.description: Band theory, carrier transport, junctions, MOSFET physics, FinFETs and nanosheets, reliability and the compact models EDA tools consume.

domains.name: Digital Logic Design
domains.description: Combinational and sequential logic, flip-flop timing, FSMs, adders and multipliers, pipelines and memories, for a mathematician entering hardware.

domains.name: Fabrication and Design-Technology Co-optimization
domains.description: Process steps, lithography, OPC and multiple patterning, the interconnect stack, PDKs and design rules, DTCO and yield.

domains.name: CMOS Circuits and Cell Libraries
domains.description: Static CMOS, logical effort, power, standard-cell layout and the Liberty abstraction every digital tool consumes.

domains.name: HDLs and Hardware Compilers
domains.description: Verilog, SystemVerilog and VHDL semantics, elaboration, ASTs, IRs, SSA and dataflow analysis, RTLIL, MLIR and CIRCT.

domains.name: Logic Synthesis
domains.description: Two-level and multi-level minimization, don't cares, AIGs and rewriting, FSM synthesis, retiming, e-graphs, Yosys and ABC.

domains.name: Formal Verification
domains.description: SAT and CDCL, BDDs, equivalence checking, model checking, BMC, k-induction, IC3, SMT and assertions.

domains.name: Functional Verification and Simulation
domains.description: Event-driven and compiled simulation, testbenches, constrained random, coverage, UVM, emulation and CDC.

domains.name: Circuit Simulation
domains.description: Modified nodal analysis, Newton with companion models, transient integration and step control, AC, PSS, Monte Carlo and model order reduction.

domains.name: Technology Mapping and Sizing
domains.description: Tree and DAG covering, cuts, LUT mapping, Boolean matching, gate sizing and buffer insertion.

domains.name: High-Level Synthesis
domains.description: CDFGs, scheduling, allocation and binding, pipelining and modulo scheduling, from algorithm to RTL.

domains.name: Static Timing Analysis
domains.description: Timing graphs, delay models, clocks and constraints, OCV, AOCV, POCV and SSTA, incremental timing and timing closure.

domains.name: Test and Design for Test
domains.description: Fault models, fault simulation, ATPG, scan and compression, BIST, JTAG, diagnosis and yield learning.

domains.name: Floorplanning and Placement
domains.description: Floorplan representations, wirelength models, quadratic and electrostatic placement, legalization, detailed and timing-driven placement.

domains.name: Analog, Mixed-Signal and RF Design Automation
domains.description: Small-signal design, op-amps, data converters and PLLs, sizing as optimization, matching and analog layout, RF and mixed-signal simulation.

domains.name: FPGA CAD
domains.description: FPGA architecture, packing, annealing placement, PathFinder routing and open FPGA toolchains.

domains.name: Clock Trees and Power Delivery
domains.description: Clock tree synthesis, zero-skew and useful skew, clock gating, power grids, IR drop, decap, EM and low-power intent.

domains.name: Routing
domains.description: Maze and A* routing, pattern and global routing, negotiated congestion, layer assignment, detailed and channel routing.

domains.name: Extraction, Signal Integrity and Signoff
domains.description: Parasitic extraction, SPEF, RC reduction, crosstalk and noise, ECOs and the signoff checklist.

domains.name: Physical Verification and DFM
domains.description: GDSII and OASIS, DRC engines, LVS as graph matching, antenna and fill, hotspots and tape-out.

domains.name: PCB Design
domains.description: Schematic to layout, stackups and controlled impedance, differential pairs, vias, manufacturing outputs and board-level SI.

domains.name: Packaging, Chiplets and 3D Integration
domains.description: Flip chip and BGA, interposers, TSVs, hybrid bonding, UCIe, thermal, mechanical and reliability physics.

domains.name: Building EDA Software
domains.description: Design databases, format parsers, incremental computation, deterministic parallelism, regression and QoR, and the open-source RTL-to-GDS flow hands-on.

domains.name: Machine Learning for EDA
domains.description: GNNs on netlists, congestion and timing prediction, RL placement and its debate, surrogates and Bayesian optimization, LLMs for RTL.

domains.name: Agent-First EDA Architecture
domains.description: Engines built for agents: the four-layer model, skills and harness loops, change tiers and seams, golden tests, the skill flywheel, tool-grounded RL and agentic signoff.

tracks.name: EDA Tool Designer: the full ramp
tracks.description: Every EDA domain in dependency order, from the flow and its mathematics to agent-first engine architecture. The aggressive path to designing modern EDA tools.

tracks.name: Physical Design Engines
tracks.description: Partitioning, placement, clock trees, routing, extraction and physical verification, with the timing and optimization they rest on.

tracks.name: Synthesis and Verification Engines
tracks.description: Boolean reasoning, HDL compilers, logic synthesis, technology mapping, HLS, simulation, formal verification and test.

tracks.name: Circuits, Devices and Simulation
tracks.description: Electromagnetics, devices, fabrication, CMOS cells, circuit simulation and analog design automation.

tracks.name: Agent-First EDA Architect
tracks.description: The landscape, the software infrastructure of real tools, machine learning for EDA, and agent-first engine architecture.

tracks.name: Boards, Packages and FPGAs
tracks.description: FPGA CAD, PCB design, packaging, chiplets and 3D integration.
